about_the_game:
Alone in the vast expanse of space, you are the Space Survivor. Choose a unique class of spaceship and survive the onslaught of factions defending their territory.

Features

  • Fight Countless Waves of Enemies: Face off against swarms of alien adversaries with unique behaviors and attack patterns, creating an ever-intensifying bullet hell experience.

  • Equip and Upgrade: Manage multiple weapons simultaneously, each with its own upgrade path. Collect and utilize a variety of power-ups to enhance your combat effectiveness.

  • Gather Resources: Accumulate gold and alien artifacts during each run to purchase permanent upgrades and unlock new abilities, bettering chances of survival in subsequent attempts.

  • Roguelite Elements: Each death is not the end but a stepping stone. Use the collected resources to upgrade your skills, unlocking new weapons and abilities to aid in future runs.
